system.description:
Musical performance is a powerful tool. It can impress an emotion upon the listener—seducing, enraging, pleasing, etc. Choose an instrument: Drum, Flute and Lyre are but a few of the many options.

Obstacles: Will of the listener. If the music is suitable to the mood, add advantage. The obstacle can be used for linked tests or to convey an idea.

FoRKs: Sing, Composition, and additional instruments

Skill Type: Musical. Tools: Yes, an instrument.

Root: Will/Agility

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 285
